metadata.title: Country Rock Stencil and Spray Aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic composition featuring a musician against a textured blue wall with large-scale, dripping stencil typography and floating elements.
triggerTerms: dripping stencil text on blue wall

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast scene set against a deep blue, textured plaster wall. A central figure in dark clothing interacts with musical equipment, while large, white, spray-painted stencil letters dominate the right side, featuring vertical paint drips. A white cowboy hat appears to float above the figure, adding a surreal, kinetic energy.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned diagonally to create movement
Large-scale typography balanced against the human figure
Floating hat aligned vertically with the subject's head
Red amplifier providing a singular warm-toned anchor
coreInvariants: White spray-paint stencil effect with visible drips
High-contrast lighting with soft shadows on the wall

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure on the left third, scaled to approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A bright red rectangular amplifier in the bottom right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the floating hat, follows the figure's body down to the guitar, then moves right across the large stencil text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blue space around the floating hat and between the figure and the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and floating hat
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the amplifier and yellow-gold for the guitar body
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white elements and dark background; low saturation overall except for the red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Rough, fuzzy edges simulating spray paint
Vertical drips extending from the bottom of characters
Inconsistent baseline for a hand-applied look
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'W' and 'A' have exaggerated, sharp angles
Drips are concentrated on the heaviest horizontal strokes

composition.relationshipToImage: painted directly onto the background wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy industrial stencil paired with a loose, casual hand-drawn signature script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the basic blocky stencil structure for modification.
Captures the gritty, eroded spray paint texture.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a black t-shirt and jeans playing a yellow electric guitar, one foot resting on a red amplifier, against a textured navy blue wall. A white cowboy hat is levitating in the air above him. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large white stencil-style text with spray paint drips on the right side of the wall. Add a hand-written signature-style name in white at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Are there visible paint drips on the large text?
Is the background wall a textured navy blue?
Is the cowboy hat floating without visible support?
Is the red amplifier the primary color accent?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the stencil text looks integrated into the wall texture.
Ensure the floating hat has a realistic shadow on the wall.
Verify the red of the amp is the most saturated element.
Confirm the drips do not obscure the legibility of the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject + Instrument + Floating Accessory + Textured Wall + Stencil Typography with Drips
